meta.subject: Noir Essence Fragrance
meta.about_summary: Noir Essence crafts 'liquid shadows,' unique fragrances for modern visionaries. Our scents, born from moonlit moments, blend ancient wisdom with modern design for an understated, sophisticated, and deeply personal signature.

creativeDirection.inspirationReference: The feeling of liquid shadows, midnight air, the texture of heavy silk, hushed secrets.

featured_items.title: Noir Essence Signature Scent
featured_items.description: A unique fragrance that evolves with skin chemistry, offering a multi-sensory depth of smoky agarwood, black roses, and dark cacao.

product.name: Noir Essence
product.tagline: Liquid Shadows for the Modern Visionary
product.sensory_description: Experience liquid shadows: crisp midnight air, smoky agarwood, velvet black roses. Feels like weightless heavy silk, warming to a rich, resinous glow. Evokes bittersweet dark cacao and spices, a whispered secret of amber and musk.
product.origin_story: Born from a quest to bottle the scent of a moonlit world where cold air meets warm shadows. Our philosophy: true elegance lingers. We blend ancient botanical wisdom with modern sensory design to capture the raw, dark beauty of the night.
product.target_customer: Modern visionaries (25-45), creative professionals, urban sophisticates valuing understated luxury, intellectual depth, substance, minimalism, quiet power, and individuality.
